instructions: In this task you will see black shapes appear on the screen one at a time. You will respond to them by pressing the "Z" and "M" keys. Only one key is correct for each shape. The correct keys are as follows: [prompt_text] These instructions will remain on the screen during practice, but will be removed during the test phase. You should respond as quickly and accurately as possible to each shape. For the rest of the experiment, on some proportion of trials a black "stop signal" in the shape of a star will appear around the shape.
